description: This Java source file defines the AclNotAllowedException class, a custom exception indicating that a Thing's JSON schema version does not permit an Access Control List. It includes methods for creating instances from messages or JSON objects, and a builder class for constructing exceptions with specific details.

classes.name: AclNotAllowedException
classes.description: A final class representing an exception thrown when a Thing's JSON schema version does not allow an Access Control List. It includes static methods for creating instances and a nested builder class.

classes.name: AclNotAllowedException.Builder
